name: Ash Escanor
saveNotes: Fey Ancestry: advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.text:
Make a melee attack with your weapon. On a hit the target takes the weapon's normal effects plus 1d8 Thunder, and is sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn: if it willingly moves 5 feet or more, it takes 2d8 Thunder and the spell ends.

Use it from Ashenflare's options (Booming Blade).

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.text:
You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature or object in range. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.

Cantrip Upgrade. The spell creates two beams at level 5, three beams at level 11, and four beams at level 17. You can direct the beams at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each beam.

Total Beams

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.text:
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. See the descriptions below for the effects of each. The illusion ends if you cast this spell again.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

Sound. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the spell ends.

Image. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, since things can pass through it.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.text: Spectral frost covers you: you gain 5 temporary HP per slot level. While you have them, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 Cold damage per slot level.

selfEffect.name: Armor of Agathys (melee attackers take cold)

spells.name: Hellish Rebuke
spells.trigger: taking damage from a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself
spells.text:
The creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by green flames. It makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d10 for each spell slot level above 1.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.material: bat fur and a piece of coal
spells.text:
For the duration, magical Darkness spreads from a point within range and fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere. Darkvision can't see through it, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

Alternatively, you cast the spell on an object that isn't being worn or carried, causing the Darkness to fill a 15-foot Emanation originating from that object. Covering that object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the Darkness.

If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of Bright Light or Dim Light created by a spell of level 2 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.text:
Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real.

Each time a creature hits you with an attack roll during the spell's duration, roll a d6 for each of your remaining duplicates. If any of the d6s rolls a 3 or higher, one of the duplicates is hit instead of you, and the duplicate is destroyed. The duplicates otherwise ignore all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it has the Blinded condition, Blindsight, or Truesight.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.text: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.trigger: when you see a creature within range casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components
spells.text: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

actions.name: Ashenflare (pact weapon)
actions.text: Melee weapon attack, reach 5 ft, using Charisma (Hex Warrior). Hit: 1d8 + Cha + 2 (Dueling) Slashing; versatile 1d10 (no Dueling). Thirsting Blade: attack twice with the Attack action. Attacks can come from your echo's space.

actions.name: Hexblade's Curse
actions.text: Curse a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute: +3 damage on your hits against it, and you crit it on a 19 or 20. If it dies, you regain 10 HP.

actions.name: Manifest Echo
actions.text: An echo of you appears within 15 ft: AC 17, 1 HP, immune to conditions, uses your saves. Move it 30 ft on your turn; swap places with it as a bonus action (costs 15 ft of movement). Attacks from the Attack action can come from its space; it can make opportunity attacks for you.

actions.name: Unleash Incarnation
actions.text: When you take the Attack action, make one extra melee attack from the echo's position.

actions.name: Action Surge
actions.text: Take one additional action this turn.

traits.name: Echo
traits.text: A translucent grey image of Ash. Destroyed if more than 30 ft from him at the end of his turn, if he is Incapacitated, or if he manifests another. Uses Ash's save bonuses.

features.name: Pact of the Blade
features.text: Ashenflare is your pact weapon; it counts as magical and is your spellcasting focus (Improved Pact Weapon).

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.text: Use Charisma for attack and damage with Ashenflare (included).

features.name: Thirsting Blade
features.text: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.text: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 120 ft.

features.name: Fighting Style: Dueling
features.text: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon (included).

features.name: Echo Knight
features.text: Manifest Echo and Unleash Incarnation are in Actions.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.text: Advantage on saves against being charmed; magic can't put you to sleep.

features.name: Ear to the Ground
features.text: A contact in any city who knows the local people and places.

inventory: A receipt of deposit at a bank in a far-flung city
token: Ash Escanor, a lean half-elf hexblade warlock and bounty hunter: fair skin, striking green eyes, swept-back white hair, a dark coat over a chain shirt, holding Ashenflare, a longsword with a glowing ember-red crystal set in its pommel and faint fire along the blade, a translucent grey echo of himself just behind his shoulder. Cool, wry and dangerous.
flags: Weapon: the sheet doesn't list Ash's weapon. I made Ashenflare a longsword (+8 to hit, 1d8 + 7 Slashing with Hex Warrior and Dueling). Send its real stats if it does more, like fire damage.
Booming Blade is on the sheet as a cantrip; use it from Ashenflare's options so it rides on the attack.
